content: If the DemExtendedDataRecordTrigger is set to DEM_- TRIGGER_ON_FDC_THRESHOLD , the ExtendedDataRecord shall be captured (as al- lowed by [SWS_Dem_00810]) each time the configured FDC threshold (refer to Dem- CounterBasedFdcThresholdStorageValue or DemTimeBasedFdcThreshold- StorageValue ) is reached (by a positive increment), but at most once per operation cycle.
